topic: how does the TCP handshake work
narration: The internet starts every chat with three knocks.
description: Vertical 1080x1920 dark black background. Center-safe zone holds two glowing nodes at mid-height: left laptop icon (accent=cyan glow circle with white laptop glyph, label LAPTOP in fg=white below) at 25% width, 40% height, right server stack icon (accent2=magenta glow circle with white server glyph, label SERVER below) at 75% width, 40% height, joined by faint muted=grey horizontal line. Large bold fg=white kinetic title '3 KNOCKS' centered at 50% width, 55% height on frame 0. Three glowing pulses (accent, accent2, accent3=yellow) travel along the line between nodes in rhythm.

beats.action: Frame opens on bold '3 KNOCKS' title center and both laptop and server nodes glowing; faint connecting line visible.
Title scales up slightly; connecting line brightens from muted to fg=white.
First accent=cyan pulse launches laptop to server along line, laptop node flashes larger.
Second accent2=magenta pulse launches server to laptop, server node flashes; first pulse arrives with knock ripple.
Third accent3=yellow pulse launches laptop to server, all three pulses visible in sequence with knock ripples on arrival.
